name: Kapel'ka opasnogo dozhdja
source:
What do rains conceal in themselves? For some they are a source of inspiration, others - nothing but nature's unpleasant whim. But they hide more than what it seems from the first sight. This town has been orphaned, its' only resident, the same orphan, discovers grief that stroke out of nowhere. Yet, perhaps, it's not that hopeless? And do you really want to know about another inhabitant of the town?

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/3-1-0-1381]AniVisual[/url]]
translation:
雨中究竟藏着什么？对某些人而言，它是灵感的源泉，对另一些人来说，却不过是大自然令人不快的任性。然而，它所隐藏的，远不止乍看之下的那些。这座小镇已被世界遗弃，而它唯一的居民，同样是一名孤儿，正面对着突如其来的悲痛。可是，或许事情还没有那么绝望？还有，你真的想知道镇上另一位居民的事吗？

[译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/3-1-0-1381]AniVisual[/url]]
